final.name: Quantification of real-world stakes or impact
final.audit_justification: Specific, checkable figures tied to the argument are direct evidentiary support for the comment's substance.

final.name: Disclosed firsthand expertise grounding the claims
final.audit_justification: Disclosed expertise that specifically grounds the technical claims functions as evidentiary support for those claims rather than a bare identity marker.

final.name: Comment-period timing/procedural request share
final.audit_justification: This scores what fraction of the text is devoted to a procedural/timing topic rather than judging the quality of the substance or the request.

final.name: Alternative comparison
final.audit_justification: Comparing feasible alternatives against explicit criteria is substantive analytical reasoning.

final.name: Original firsthand text vs. formulaic template language
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing situation-specific prose from template/boilerplate phrasing is a production-style fingerprint, though genuine bespoke engagement plausibly co-occurs with genuinely better substance.
final.arbiter_reason: The scored axis is whether the prose reads as freshly composed for this docket versus reusable template language, which is a fingerprint of how the comment was produced (individual submission vs. mass-campaign form letter) rather than of the strength of its evidence or argument; a bespoke but vacuous comment scores 10 and a templated comment carrying real technical substance scores 0. Bespoke authorship does plausibly co-occur with genuine firsthand engagement and better substance, so it belongs in both readouts.

final.name: Scanned-attachment ingestion signature: stub, OCR garble, page furniture
final.audit_justification: This explicitly scores a scanned-attachment filing-mode fingerprint and disclaims judging whether it makes the comment worse, though formal scanned letters often come from more resourced or professional filers who may also write stronger substance.
final.upstream_parent: submission medium (paper/fax/scanned PDF attachment versus native electronic text entry), plus the corpus's own OCR pipeline

final.name: Content exceeds its packaging rather than the reverse
final.audit_justification: Judging whether dense, non-redundant content exists beneath the presentational apparatus is a substance-density assessment.

final.name: Technical precision achieved concisely (technical economy)
final.audit_justification: Combining verifiable technical detail with brevity (no padding) is a craft/economy dimension of substantive quality.

final.name: Legal/regulatory citation apparatus density
final.audit_justification: Explicitly an extent-only measure of formal citation/legal-formality apparatus, a venue-style marker, though it may co-occur with more professionally-resourced drafters who also produce stronger substance.

final.name: Technical substantiation vs. ideological/emotional characterization
final.audit_justification: Directly judges whether persuasive force rests on technical substantiation versus charged rhetoric.

final.name: Organizational scale self-description
final.audit_justification: Purely detects whether the text states organizational scale, explicitly disclaiming any judgment of argument correctness, but such statements are a plausible fingerprint of a well-resourced organization that may also produce genuinely stronger substance.

final.name: Uncertainty calibration
final.audit_justification: Distinguishing facts, inferences, and unknowns and proposing how to resolve them is genuine epistemic rigor.

final.name: Historical or precedential grounding of the request
final.audit_justification: Situating the argument in relevant regulatory history or precedent is substantive contextual grounding.

final.name: Short decisive comment from a directly exposed party
final.audit_justification: Penalizing padding and restatement while rewarding a decisive, well-supported position is a content-density judgment of substance, not raw length.

final.name: OCR and transcription artifacts
final.audit_justification: Explicitly an extent-only document-conversion artifact fingerprint disclaiming any link to substantive quality, though it correlates with formal filings that may also carry genuinely better substance.

final.name: Distributional Impact Analysis
final.audit_justification: Examining differential effects across multiple affected groups is substantive analytical depth.

final.name: Argument-carried weight vs. appeal to institutional size
final.audit_justification: Directly judges whether the argument's force comes from reasoning and evidence versus a substitute appeal to organizational size.

final.name: Technical identifier density
final.audit_justification: A pure density measure of technical identifiers disclaiming correctness, a jargon/style marker that may co-occur with genuine technical substance.

final.name: Builds a record: exhibits, indexes, citations, companion filings
final.audit_justification: Citing named sources, studies, and cross-references builds genuine evidentiary support for the argument.

final.name: Attachment-index / cover-page share of text
final.audit_justification: Measures what share of the visible text is index/cover-page routing material rather than substance, a pure structural-composition marker with no plausible link to better substantive content.

final.name: Professional production markers
final.audit_justification: Explicitly an extent-only measure of production polish (letterhead, signatory presentation) disclaiming quality judgment, a classic well-resourced-producer fingerprint that may co-occur with genuinely stronger substance.

final.name: Document volume
final.audit_justification: A pure document-length/volume measure disclaimed as not judging quality, though longer submissions from motivated or resourced filers may also carry genuinely more substance.

final.name: Applicability Boundaries
final.audit_justification: Precisely delimiting which cases are and are not covered, with a reason, is substantive analytical precision.

final.name: Mechanism-to-effect reasoning
final.audit_justification: Explaining a mechanism-to-consequence chain rather than bare assertion is substantive causal reasoning.

final.name: Professional legal drafting
final.audit_justification: An extent-only measure of lawyerly drafting conventions disclaiming quality judgment, plausibly co-occurring with professionally-resourced drafters who also produce stronger substance.
